sampler_decision.rationale: This card completes deterministic held-out EVIDENCE for existing arms (per-fold MAP refits, exact eigenbases, held-out scoring). It makes no new posterior or uncertainty claim, so no sampler is required. NUTS/HMC remains the project default for Bayesian updating (AGENTS Sampler Rule). Every MAP number here is a deterministic optimizer result, NOT a posterior summary.

nonconvergence_carried.meaning: arms B and C are scored at a deterministic MAP because their NUTS posteriors are multimodal / non-converged. Their POSTERIOR UNCERTAINTY IS UNRESOLVED. Per the review's C2 correction the amplitude likelihood is locally stiff but globally unidentified; MAP scores are optimizer results only and are never trustworthy as intervals.

armC_exact.method: deterministic multi-start (n=4) L-BFGS-B MAP of the shape field, refit INDEPENDENTLY per LODO fold on that fold's 3 TRAIN drives only, on the exact-at-theta_MAP basis A0_wide__enr; scored at theta=ones. NO SAMPLER.
armC_exact.replaces: the study's WITHDRAWN leaky exact arm-C aggregate (0.1570), which applied fold m_xpos_990x's shape MAP to all 4 folds (review C6)

defect_decomposition.probe: decomposition of the study's arm-C exact defect into leak vs basis mismatch
defect_decomposition.reading: the study's exact arm-C number carries TWO defects, not one. Review C6 caught the leak (+0.082). It did NOT catch that the shape-field raw coefficients were fit in the theta=1 eigenbasis and then applied to the theta_MAP eigenbasis -- different eigenvectors, so the coefficients were transplanted between incompatible coordinate systems (-0.085). The two errors nearly cancelled, which is why 0.157 looked plausible next to the honest 0.1595.

armC_exact.finding: the study's 0.1570 was RIGHT BY ACCIDENT. Its exact arm-C path carries TWO defects that nearly cancelled: (1) the leak review C6 caught (fold-1's MAP on all 4 folds) is worth +0.0822; (2) a basis mismatch the review did NOT catch -- the shape-field raw coefficients were fit in the A0_wide theta=1 eigenbasis (r=209, 18 modes, r0=106) and applied to the A0_wide__enr theta_MAP eigenbasis (r=194, 19 modes, r0=108), i.e. transplanted between incompatible coordinate systems -- is worth -0.0847. Net -0.0025 from the honest 0.1595. Near-agreement between a defective and a correct number is NOT evidence the defect is harmless. Separately, the study's sentence 'on the exact basis C's lead collapses' is WRONG as stated: A1 dropped on the exact basis too, so C's LEAD over A1 is essentially unchanged (+0.044 screening -> +0.046 exact). What fails S1 is PRECISION (per-fold deltas -0.034..+0.132), not collapse.

S1.claim: an eligible arm (B/C/D/F) beats A1 by >= +0.05 AND >= 2x paired-fold SE, sub-200 Hz
S1.note: Best eligible arm D beats A1-exact by +0.0497, which clears 2x paired SE (0.0348) but MISSES the +0.05 magnitude bar by 0.0003. Unchanged in verdict from the repair; arm C's row is now the honest T1 refit rather than the withdrawn leaky one.
S1.F_rule: F = C (B does not beat A1; C beats A1; D does not beat C) — NOT best-arm, NOT R.
S1.source: isolated repair + T1 arm-C refits (this card)

exact_selected.convention: winner's-curse-honest: each track's BEST EXACT candidate (select and report on the same trustworthy metric)
exact_selected.caveat: a per-track maximum over 14 noisy candidates carries selection noise in BOTH arms; a sub-SE gap is not a win for either track

S2.coverage: 28/28 loop candidates exact-scored (0 excluded-with-reason) — the study exact-scored only 2/28 (review C1)
S2.scope_limitation_D16: all 14 agent candidates were thickness/scale/split edits; the agent proposed ZERO genuine model-form (mesh/connectivity) changes. Any H2 reading is 'within a mostly-parametric edit space', NOT 'agent-proposed geometry/mesh/connectivity edits failed'.
